title: Creating your boat
description: Set up your first boat in AftLog so tracking starts off right.

steps.text: Tap + on the Boats tab, or 'Add Boat'.
Enter the make, model, and year.
Add engine details — type, make, model, horsepower.
Save. AftLog creates your boat dashboard and log.

tips: You can add more boats later (Pro unlocks unlimited).
Engine details power the fuel-range and interval features.
affects: Feed the dashboard, intervals, and cost insights.
examples: A 2008 Lund 1650 with a 90 HP outboard.
Your fishing rig with the engine model filled in.
